events.name: Diwali in the Hutt
events.note: Enquire with us for stalls, performances and volunteering.
events.description:
This event brings together the best of Diwali celebrations for everyone to enjoy, whether you're marking the occasion with your family or experiencing it for the first time.

Cultural Performances — Enjoy a vibrant program of traditional and contemporary dance and music
Food Stalls — Sample a delicious range of festive food from local vendors
Retail Stalls — Browse unique products, clothing, and gifts
Kids' Activities — A dedicated zone to keep the little ones entertained all day
Face Painting — Fun designs for children of all ages
Henna Corners — Get beautifully hand-painted henna designs
Spot Prizes & Raffles — Stick around for chances to win great prizes throughout the day
A celebration for everyone

Diwali symbolises the victory of light over darkness and good over evil. This event is a chance for our whole community — regardless of background — to come together, share in the festivities, and celebrate the rich traditions of Diwali.

Bring your family and friends and be part of the light this Labour Weekend!
